app.name: Sprout
app.tagline: Learn English like tending a tree

common.errorBody: We could not load this. Please try again.

landing.heroTitle: Learn English like tending a tree
landing.heroBody: Sprout teaches all five skills, scores your pronunciation down to the phoneme, and reminds you to review right before you forget.
landing.featureSpeakingBody: Read a sentence into your microphone and see exactly which word and which sound went wrong, with mouth-shape guidance for the mistakes Vietnamese speakers make most.
landing.featureSrsBody: Words you meet in a reading or listening lesson join your review queue automatically.
landing.featureTutorBody: The tutor reads your level, your recurring mistakes and your recent lessons, so explanations land at the right depth.

auth.loginSubtitle: Your tree is waiting to be watered.
auth.registerSubtitle: Create an account and start learning in two minutes.

onboarding.goalsSubtitle: Pick everything that applies. We order topics around your answer.
onboarding.timeTitle: How long can you study each day?
onboarding.timeSubtitle: Choose what you can keep up, not what you wish for.
onboarding.levelTitle: What is your level right now?
onboarding.levelSubtitle: Not sure is fine. A 15 minute test will work it out.
onboarding.levelUnknown: I do not know, test me

dashboard.emptyStateBody: Learn your first five words to make the seed sprout.

lesson.typoForgiven: Small spelling slip, still counted correct
lesson.tapToBuild: Tap the chunks below to build the sentence
lesson.diffLegend: A dotted underline is a small spelling slip, a dashed box is a missing word, a strikethrough is an extra word, and a red background is the wrong word. ♪ means the right sound but the wrong word.

grammar.title: Grammar
grammar.subtitle: Every lesson gives you theory, examples, memory tips and the mistakes Vietnamese learners actually make, before any exercises.
grammar.emptyTitle: No lessons at this level yet
grammar.emptyBody: Pick another level, or come back once more content is added.
grammar.loadFailed: This lesson could not be loaded.
grammar.startFailed: The exercises are locked. You may need to finish an earlier lesson.

reading.title: Reading
reading.subtitle: Passages by level, with word lookup inside the text and your reading speed measured against the target.
reading.emptyTitle: No passages at this level yet
reading.emptyBody: Pick another level, or come back once more content is added.
reading.loadFailed: This passage could not be loaded.
reading.tapHint: Tap a highlighted word to see what it means.

reading.wpmTarget: the target for this level is {target}

listening.title: Listening
listening.subtitle: Listen at your own speed, open the transcript when you need it, then take dictation to test your ear.
listening.emptyBody: Try removing a filter, or come back once more content is added.
listening.loadFailed: This track could not be loaded.
listening.transcriptHidden: The transcript is hidden. Try listening first.
listening.synthesisNotice: There is no recording yet, so your browser is reading the transcript. Tap a segment to replay just that line.
listening.noAudioSupport: This browser cannot read text aloud. You can still read the transcript.
listening.dictationIntro: Listen to each line and type it back word for word.

tests.title: Tests
tests.subtitle: The placement test adapts to your answers and gives you a CEFR level for each skill.
tests.emptyBody: More content is on the way.
tests.metaAdaptive: about {minutes} min · length depends on your answers

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: What you actually studied, and what the numbers say about your weak spots.
analytics.emptyBody: Study for a few sessions and come back.
analytics.noWeakSpots: Not enough data to name a weak spot — at least 5 questions on a topic are needed.

writing.title: Writing
writing.subtitle: Submit a piece, get scored on four criteria, see every mistake marked in place with the reason, and read a rewrite one level above you.
writing.gradingNotice: Grading takes 10–20 seconds. You get 3 free submissions a day.
writing.sampleHidden: Reading the model answer after writing your own is far more useful.
writing.sampleAfterAttempt: The model answer appears after your first submission.
writing.tapIssue: Tap an underlined phrase to see why it is wrong.

tutor.title: AI Tutor
tutor.subtitle: Ask anything about English. The tutor answers in Vietnamese and puts corrections to your English in a separate box.
tutor.quotaSpent: You have used today’s allowance. It resets at 4am.
tutor.notConfigured: AI is not configured. Add AI_API_KEY to .env to switch it on.
tutor.emptyBody: Ask a question, or pick a suggestion below.
tutor.failed: No answer came back. Try again.
tutor.placeholder: Type a question… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
tutor.suggestion1: When do I use have been and when have gone?
tutor.suggestion2: Explain the difference between make and do
tutor.suggestion3: Why is "I very like it" wrong?
tutor.suggestion4: How do articles a, an, the work for a beginner?

speaking.title: Speaking
speaking.subtitle: Read a sentence aloud and get scored word by word, with the sounds you missed named. Or practise a real situation with the AI.
speaking.notConfigured: Pronunciation scoring is not configured. Set AI_SPEECH_PROVIDER and AI_SPEECH_API_KEY in .env.
speaking.noRecorder: This browser cannot record. Try Chrome or Edge.
speaking.micDenied: Microphone access is blocked. Re-enable it in your browser settings and try again.
speaking.roleplayStart: Type or say your first line to begin. The character replies in English.
speaking.turnFailed: That turn could not be sent.
